description.blurb: S/2007 S 6 is a natural satellite of Saturn, belonging to the Norse group. It was discovered in 2007 and announced in 2023.
description.more: S/2007 S 6 is about 3 kilometers in diameter and orbits Saturn at an average distance of 18.5 million km in 949.5 days. It has an inclination of 166.5° to the ecliptic in a retrograde direction with an eccentricity of 0.169.
